notes.title: 🔥 Versão 1.2.0
notes.content:
🔥 Version 1.2.0
✅ What's New
Added a full custom key remapping system! Players can now set their own controls.

Introduced a new zombie enemy that drops extra coins when defeated.

🐞 Fixes & Improvements
General bug fixes and stability improvements.

notes.title: 📦 Apocalypse Rush — Version 1.1.21 (Patch Notes)
notes.content:
🔧 Bug Fixes:
✅ Fixed an issue with the “Ghost Zone” modifier where, if the player died while it was active, returning to the stage would result in enemies no longer dropping items or coins.

✅ Fixed a bug with the “Cat Drone” modifier where the drone’s bullets were not playing their sound effects.

🎨 Visual Improvements:
✨ Added a visual effect for the “Reduced Speed” modifier, making it clearer when the player is slowed.

🐌 Introduced an animated snail, which works as a visual timer for the Reduced Speed effect. The snail moves from one side to the other, showing how long the effect will last.

🚀 Version: 1.1.21
(This update focuses on bug fixes and minor visual improvements.)
